name: zavora-work-studio-shell
description: Desktop shell for Zavora Work Studio. Supervises the Core and renders the product surface.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json && vite build
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json --noEmit
